failed_or_abandoned: Thermalisation defined by max over T of Gamma K1/K2 / H: diverges towards T << m (no fermions can produce an A'), gave eps_therm ~ 1e-10 with a freeze-in yield only 0.3 % of equilibrium; replaced by Y_FI = Y_eq(T=m) (criterion A) cross-checked with Gamma K1/K2 = H at T = m/3 (criterion B), which agree within x1.4.

LSODA on the stiff dark-Higgs Boltzmann equation returned the initial condition unchanged (Omega h^2 ~ 1e5) without an error flag; replaced by Radau with an analytic Jacobian (agrees with the analytic Omega h^2 estimate to x2).

Inverted T_nu/T_gamma ratio after neutrino decoupling (g* = 17.9 at 0.1 MeV) and missing GeV^-1 -> s conversion plus decreasing-abscissa np.interp in t(T) (t(1 MeV) = 1e24): both caught by the validation printout and fixed (g* = 3.371, t(1 MeV) = 0.745 s, t(z=1100) = 1.16e13 s).
T grid initially stopped at 10 keV, clamping T(t) for tau > 1e4 s and corrupting the FIRAS mu/y estimates; extended to 0.1 eV.
s-wave unitarity ceiling applied in the classical (many-partial-wave) SIDM regime; restricted to m_chi v/m_A' < 1.
r = m_h/m_A' = 1.0 exactly gives zero phase space in both annihilation formulae (no evolution); dropped in favour of 0.99 and 1.05.
